<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 193.110 which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 192.103 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 12 % of M) indicates about 12 carbon atoms (each ¹³C contributes ~1.1 %). A formula with 12 carbons that matches the mass is C₁₂H₁₆O₂ (monoisotopic mass 192.115 Da), which is within typical experimental error for the measurement. Therefore the molecular formula is C₁₂H₁₆O₂.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H16O2</final_answer>
